Steps to Creative Thinking

  1. Preparation - a long process involving wide reading, attending lectures and seminars, talking with others �interested in the activity. Reading notes and related materials etc...

  2. Incubation - After gathering the needed facts and opinions the creative thinker does not work on his problem but devotes time thinking about it at odd times.

  3. Inspiration - the thinker starts to see new relationships, new ideas. A rather sudden solution to the material has been reached.

  4. Verification & Revision - Objective data are necessary to confirm the correctness of the inspiration. The thinker checks and rechecks his theory or hypothesis through experimentation more observation, reading, revision of his thinking and so on. Minor changes are likely to be made as a result.
